1074-1432-4613.easyPrerequisites:
King Macar doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ioreth of the Healing House is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1074-1432-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1074-1432-4613.description:
Activate King Macar using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping King Macar
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do.
Repeat.

512-2872-3814.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.

Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Argothian Elder, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5413-7889.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5413-7889.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5413-7889.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

2073-5231-7876-7878.description:

When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

2098-5531-7813.description:

Vesuva's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Vesuva enters as a tapped copy of Lumra.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.

Repeat from step 2.
1621-4605-7260.notes: If Nature's Rhythm is in your hand, {G}{G} is removed from the cost. However, if it's in your graveyard, you can tap a creature to also reduce the cost.

Repeat.

372-4681-4753.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Clever Impersonator.
372-4681-4753.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Clever Impersonator's abilities trigger.

Put Clever Impersonator into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.

1637-4377-4423-4482.description:

Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers twice, allowing you to draw two cards.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Aesi trigger twice.
Resolve the first Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the second Mystic Sanctuary trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Aesi triggers, causing you to draw Walk the Aeons and up to one additional card from the top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
